workload.name: analytic-scaling-e025
workload.software: analytical throughput input, not an executed neural-network training stack
workload.provenance: Entirely assumed scaling sensitivity, data/scaling_sensitivity/design.json. T(n)=22.6*(16/n)^gamma hours for 100000 abstract work units; gamma=0.33333333333333326; efficiency at 32 relative to 4 nodes=0.25. 16-node pure-training duration is the author-selected anchor. One abstract worker/node and batch integers are schema bookkeeping, not measurement metadata. Initialization/restart/checkpoint costs are separate assumptions. No task outcomes were used to fit these throughput values.
